protocol: Stock V2 on randomized carpet. Stand under factory SitStand for 1 s; switch to Walk with fresh Walk action filters and retained IMU/physics at 50 Hz. At t=2 s require 0.4 s continuously upright then apply backward force along trunk heading for 0.10 s at COM. Count recovery if never fallen and continuously upright for the final 1 s of 5.10 s. Zero velocity command.
